content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD interface flux computation: MUSCL/TVD reconstruction, wave speeds, and HLL Riemann fluxes (BSD header L1-44; header comment mislabels the file as 'FILE main.F' at L3). 25 program units. Driver FLUXES (L52-117) dispatches on HIGH_ORDER: 'FOU' -> CONSTRUCTION_HO (4th-order, combined minmod+van Leer, ykchoi 08/28/2016 notes L56-62); 'FMI' -> CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (kept for tests; Choi found 4th+minmod unstable, switched off 08/31/2016, L70-74); 'WEN' -> CONSTRUCTION_WENO (CARTESIAN only, L78-85); 'MLP' -> CONSTRUCTION_HO_MLP (L89-96); else DelxyFun+CONSTRUCTION (2nd/3rd-order van Leer, L101-105); each followed by WAVE_SPEED (L64-65 etc.); then CONSTR=='HLL' -> FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL else FLUX_AT_INTERFACE averaging (L109-113); finally BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L115). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L128-139): P,Fx,Gx,Q,Fy,Gy = 0.5*(R+L) averages (predictor only, 'dont use it for TVD' L122). FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L150-161): six HLL calls pairing flux L/R with conserved-variable L/R (P from PL/PR with EtaRxL/R, Q, Fx with HUxL/R, Fy with HUyL/R, Gx with HVxL/R, Gy with HVyL/R, L154-159). HLL (L171-194): FOUT=FL if SL>=0, FR if SR<=0, else (SR*FL-SL*FR+SL*SR*(UR-UL))/(SR-SL) with denominator replaced by SMALL when |SR-SL|<SMALL (L179-190). DelxyFun (L204-229): van-Leer-limited slopes DelxEtar/DelxU/DelxV/DelxHU/DelxHV and y analogs via DelxFun/DelyFun (Eta or EtaScreen under UseEtaScreen). DelyFun (L239-283)/DelxFun (L293-336): harmonic-mean van Leer limited slope DOUT=(TMP1*|TMP2|+|TMP1|*TMP2)/(|TMP1|+|TMP2|) with zero when |TMP1|+|TMP2|<SMALL (L262-269, L316-322), one-sided differences at the two boundary rows/columns (L273-281, L326-334); non-CARTESIAN uses DY(I,J-1)/DX(I-1,J) for the backward slope (L259-260, L313-314). WAVE_SPEED (L352-439, Zhou et al. 2001 approach L365; history notes Steve Brandt ghost-cell remark and Dmitry's M1/N1 bug fix 10/29/2012, L344-349): x-interface SQR_PHI_L/R=sqrt(g|HxL/R|), SQR_PHI_S=0.5*(L+R)+0.25*(UL-UR), U_S=0.5*(UL+UR)+SQR_PHI_L-SQR_PHI_R, SxL=min(UL-SQR_PHI_L,U_S-SQR_PHI_S), SxR=max(UR+SQR_PHI_R,U_S+SQR_PHI_S) over interior (L369-378), ghost strips copied from nearest interior (L381-401); y-interface analog SyL/SyR (L404-413) with ghost copies (L417-437). CONSTRUCTION (L452-689): allocates MASK9u/MASK9v extending MASK9 to Mloc1/Nloc1 (L462-469, ykchoi 09/07/2015); CONSTRUCT_X of U,V,HU,HV,Eta(/EtaScreen) giving *xL/*xR interface states (L473-481); HxL/R=EtaRxL/R+Depthx (L482-483); CARTESIAN DISPERSION adds U4,V4 construction (L486-494, DelxV4 added per ykchoi L490-493); then flux assembly — PL/PR=HUxL/R+Gamma1*MASK9u*HxL/R*U4xL/R (L502-507; ZALPHA same L513-517; else PL=HUxL L520-521), FxL/R=Gamma3*PL/R*(UxL/R+Gamma1*MASK9u*U4xL/R)+0.5*GRAV*(EtaRx^2*Gamma3+2*EtaRx*Depthx) (L529-537; plain L553-556), GxL/R=HxL/R*(UxL/R+Gamma1*U4xL/R)*(VxL/R+Gamma1*V4xL/R)*Gamma3 per Shi et al. 2012 (L564-572; non-CARTESIAN GxL=HxL*UxL*VxL*Gamma3 L576-577); y-direction mirror with CONSTRUCT_Y, QL/QR, FyL/FyR cross-flux, GyL/GyR pressure-flux (L583-687; non-CARTESIAN FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL*Gamma3 L649-650). CONSTRUCT_Y (L702-746)/CONSTRUCT_X (L759-800): piecewise-linear reconstruction OutL(I,J)=Vin(I,J-1)+0.5*DY*Din(I,J-1), OutR=Vin(I,J)-0.5*DY*Din(I,J) (L724-728, L780-784) with one-sided ends and OutL(1)=OutR(1), OutR(N1)=OutL(N1) (L733-740, L788-795); Kappa argument retained but meaningless per ykchoi (L716-719, L772-775). CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L816-1031) + CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod (L1045-1148) / CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod (L1163-1267): Yamamoto et al. (1998) 4th-order compact stencil — triple minmod-like DVP1/DVP2/DVP3 from successive differences with factor-2 caps (L1069-1083), dry-cell fallbacks (lower-order when MASK(I-2)/(I+1)==0 L1086-1106, zero gradient when MASK(I-1)/MASK(I)==0 L1108-1112), Din=TXP2-(1/6)*(DVP3-2*DVP2+DVP1) (L1114), then interface values OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+(1/6)*(TXP1+2*TXP2), OutR=Vin(I,J)-(1/6)*(TXP3+2*TXP4) using 4-times-limited Din pairs (L1121-1144; 'HUGE bug ... 12 should versus 43, fixed' note L1131); same flux assembly as CONSTRUCTION (L860-1029). VANLEER_LIMITER function (L1280-1294; harmonic form with optional B, else (A+|A|)/(1+A)) and MINMOD_LIMITER function (L1296-1310, SIGN/MAX/MIN form) — both currently unused (calls commented at L267,L320). CONSTRUCTION_HO (L1324-1524, Erduran et al. 2005 hybrid FV-FD reference L1318-1320) + CONSTRUCT_HO_X (L1531-1639) / CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L1646-1754): 4th-order MUSCL-TVD — minmod-limited Din as above (L1545-1601), then van Leer weights VAN1/VAN2 from slope ratios RAT with SMALL floors (L1606-1616), OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+(1/6)*(VAN1*TMP1+2*VAN2*TMP2), OutR=Vin(I,J)-(1/6)*(2*VAN1*TMP1+VAN2*TMP2) (L1618,L1634); same flux assembly (L1359-1522). CONSTRUCTION_HO_MLP (L1761-1953; same as CONSTRUCTION_HO but using MLP reconstructors, comment L1757-1759) + CONSTRUCT_HO_X_MLP (L1958-2027) / CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_MLP (L2032-2102): multi-dimensional limiting process — slope ratios gamL=TXP2/TXP1, gamR=TXP2/TXP3 with smallv=1e-10 guards (L1974,L1984-1990), transverse-gradient ratios tanth1/tanth2 (L1992-1998), augmented limiter bound alphL/R=max(1,min(2,alphLin)) with alphLin=2*max(1,gam)*(1+max(0,gam*tanth))/(1+tanth) (L2003-2005,L2015-2017), slopes slopeL/R=max(0,min(alph*gam,min(alph,beta))) with beta=(1+2*gam)/3 (L1986,L2007,L2019), OutL=Vin(I-1,J)+0.5*slopeL*Txp1, OutR=Vin(I,J)-0.5*slopeR*Txp3 (L2009,L2021; y analog L2084,L2096). CONSTRUCTION_WENO (L2121-2287, CARTESIAN only, spherical removed due to U4xL conflict L2119,L2288) + WENO_CONSTRUCT_X (L2301-2381) / WENO_CONSTRUCT_Y (L2392-2472): 5th-order WENO for constant dx (references Qiu and Shu 2005; Shu 2009, L2297-2299) — smoothness indicators WBETA0/1/2=13/12*TXP1^2+1/4*TXP2^2 over three 3-point stencils (L2323-2333), weights W?BAR=R?/(WNEPS+WBETA?)^2 normalized to WNW? (L2335-2342), candidate polynomials WNP0/1/2 with 1/3,5/6,1/6,7/6,11/6 coefficients (L2344-2346), OutR at I-interface (L2348) and OutL from the shifted stencil set (L2351-2376); linear weights R0_R=3/10,R1_R=3/5,R2_R=1/10 and mirrored R*_L, WNEPS=1e-6, BETACOEF1=13/12, BETACOEF2=1/4 (L2314-2318, y-version L2405-2409).

verbatim_spans.text: !  Chois tests show this is unstable combination (4th + minmod), switched off 08/31/2016
! there was a HUGE bug here, 12 should versus 43, fixed. fyshi
!             There's a bug found in Dmitry's case. In x direction,
! The "kappa" is meaningless in above routines.
! I remove the option for spherical because there is conflict with U4xL

unresolved: Header block names the file 'FILE main.F' (L3) although this is fluxes.F — copy/paste artifact

In CONSTRUCTION's non-CARTESIAN branch FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL*Gamma3 and FyR likewise (L649-650) multiply Gamma3 twice, inconsistent with GxL=HxL*UxL*VxL*Gamma3 (L576-577) and with the single-Gamma3 forms in CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L1024-1025), CONSTRUCTION_HO (L1517-1518) and CONSTRUCTION_HO_MLP (L1946-1947) — apparent Gamma3^2 bug for spherical builds

In CONSTRUCT_HO_X_MLP/Y_MLP, gamRtanth2=tanth2/gamR is evaluated before the abs(gamR)<smallv guard (L2000-2001, L2075-2076) and gamLtanth1=tanth1/gamL likewise (L2012-2013, L2087-2088): the division by a near-zero gam occurs before the reset, risking overflow/FPE; similarly gamL/gamR themselves divide before their guards (L1984-1989)

CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod/Y_minmod take DX/DY arguments (L1045,L1163) that are never used in the reconstruction; CONSTRUCT_X/Y keep an unused Kappa argument (comments L717-719,L772-775); DelxU4/DelxV4/DelyV4/DelyU4 locals in CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L820-821) are declared but unused there

CONSTRUCTION_HO_MLP (L1779,L1867) and CONSTRUCTION_WENO (L2139,L2214) construct Eta directly with no UseEtaScreen preprocessor variant, unlike CONSTRUCTION (L477-481) and CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod/HO (L840-844,L1342-1346) — EtaScreen option silently unavailable for MLP/WENO paths

WENO_CONSTRUCT_X/Y take no MASK argument and apply no dry-cell fallback (L2301,L2392), unlike the minmod/MLP reconstructors; CONSTRUCTION_WENO exists only under CARTESIAN (L2118-2289) and the WENO scheme assumes constant dx (comments L2294-2295)

MLP reconstructors read transverse neighbors Vin(I-1,J+1),Vin(I-1,J-1) etc. (L1993,L1997,L2068,L2072) without MASK checks although MASK is an argument (L1958,L2032) — MASK is unused in both MLP construct routines
FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL declares locals SR,SL,FL,FR,UL,UR (L152) that are never used (the HLL work happens in subroutine HLL)
HLL near-degenerate case divides by SMALL instead of (SR-SL) (L185-186), changing magnitude rather than limiting the flux — approximation behavior when SR is approximately SL

Wave-speed ghost-strip copies (L381-401,L417-437) use nearest interior values with the in-code remark 'this does not really matter' (L380); correctness depends on downstream use of ghost interface speeds
